name: cockpit-bridge
description: Lets the local recording cockpit drive the Contoso demo window: open files, show diffs, type, commit and push. Only active in the Contoso demo workspaces; listens on 127.0.0.1 only, with a per-window token. Also opens a Lab Guide stop (vscode://contoso-lab.cockpit-bridge/open?stop=<id>): its files as tabs, key lines softly tinted.

commands.title: Contoso Lab Guide: open a stop
Contoso Lab Guide: next file of this stop
Contoso Lab Guide: previous file of this stop
Contoso Lab Guide: clear the stop highlight
